regressions: Opening inbox (new in 58728e8): the offer's Reply, the only way out, is below the mail's scroll fold at 5/5 viewports (50-286 px hidden) while it holds focus; the centred dialog jumps 55-409 px on every list/mail switch (CLS incl. input 0.26/0.77/2.08 at 1920/1280/390). Fixed in 7351ad8.
unresolvedRisks: Early desktop lab is mostly empty floor: content covers 12.3% of the lab at 1920 fresh, 16.3% once Collect Data opens (23-27% at 1280).
Hill labels are still cut at the canvas edge on phones ('Tokenizatio' at 390x844).
R&D's Ship it uses --accent coral, visually the same family as the danger (Erase) button; the confirm dialog then uses the amber primary.
Number suffix 'Oc' reads as '0c' in JetBrains Mono ('77.00Oc' looks like '77.000c').
Legacy screen prices are solid amber when affordable, lab prices are tinted outline pills: two affordance languages for 'you can buy this'.
Phones hide the current screen's name in the bay bar (only '⌂ server_room' shows inside the Training Cluster).
R&D room at 1920: the three slots take the top 30% of the frame; the rest is backdrop.
844x390: the pinned reply leaves about 150 px of mail text visible above it (acceptable, but tight).
